name: DECISION_V3_A_SAME_SESSION_DIAGNOSIS_V1
purpose: Outcome-blind descriptive diagnosis restricted to sessions where both A_SOFT and A_VACANCY entries occurred in the already-observed frozen Decision V3 trajectory, to remove session-level stress confounding and isolate candidate-level evidence differences.

population.paired_session_definition: session_index with at least one A_SOFT entry and at least one A_VACANCY entry

frozen_questions: Within paired sessions, does the next-session severe-exit gap between A_SOFT and A_VACANCY persist?

Within paired sessions, how do candidate evidence variables differ: current rank, previous rank, rank delta, Top10 run, Top20 run, last3 Top10 count, last3 Top20 count, t-2 rank, and t-3 rank; and what is the observed soft-rank-gap distribution for A_SOFT?
Across paired sessions, what is the equal-session-weighted difference in next-session severe incidence and candidate evidence?
Within fixed candidate-evidence reporting strata, is the direction of the A_SOFT versus A_VACANCY next-session severe gap consistent?
Is eventual severe-exit incidence directionally consistent among completed entries in paired sessions?
interpretation_guard: Same-session restriction removes session-level context differences by construction but does not randomize selection into A_SOFT versus A_VACANCY. All results remain descriptive and do not automatically authorize a successor rule.
